expected_triplets.symptom: Machine Stop during Cut Due to Unintentional pause
expected_triplets.failure_mode: intermittent pause circuit, usually in the stop discs
expected_triplets.corrective_action: Tighten the plunger to increase activation pressure

expected_triplets.symptom: The buttons on the Touch Screen are out of alignment
expected_triplets.corrective_action: Select save and exit to complete calibration

expected_triplets.symptom: The Cutting Tool or Pen does not move down
expected_triplets.failure_mode: layer is not mapped to a tool or the tool is not on the tool holder
expected_triplets.corrective_action: click and drag the tool to the spindle or the layer to the tool

expected_triplets.symptom: Laser cutting path is too wide
expected_triplets.corrective_action: Replace nozzle if any damage is present
